name: AWS Kinesis - Streams
description: The Sumo Logic App for Amazon Kinesis - Streams is an unified logs and metrics (ULM) App which provides information on the events and metrics. The preconfigured dashboards help you monitor the events, API calls, errors, incoming and outgoing records, latencies, and throughput of Kinesis Streams.

children.name: Amazon Kinesis - Streams - Events
children.description: See the details of Kinesis events including the count over time, location, API calls, errors, and users.

panels.name: Events
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/Cloudtrail/Kinesis "kinesis.amazonaws.com"
| json field=_raw "eventSource", "eventName", "awsRegion", "sourceIPAddress","userAgent" nodrop
| json field=_raw "requestParameters.streamName" as streamName nodrop
| json field=_raw "userIdentity.sessionContext.sessionIssuer.userName" as userName nodrop
| json field=_raw "userIdentity.userName" as userName nodrop
| where eventSource="kinesis.amazonaws.com"
| count by eventName

panels.name: Events Over Time
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/Cloudtrail/Kinesis "kinesis.amazonaws.com"
| json field=_raw "eventSource", "eventName", "awsRegion", "sourceIPAddress","userAgent" nodrop
| json field=_raw "requestParameters.streamName" as streamName nodrop
| json field=_raw "userIdentity.sessionContext.sessionIssuer.userName" as userName nodrop
| where eventSource="kinesis.amazonaws.com"
| timeslice 1h
| count by eventName, _timeslice
| transpose row _timeslice column eventName 
| fillmissing timeslice (1h)

panels.name: Location of Events
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/Cloudtrail/Kinesis "kinesis.amazonaws.com"
| json field=_raw "eventSource", "eventName", "awsRegion", "sourceIPAddress","userAgent" nodrop
| json field=_raw "requestParameters.streamName" as streamName nodrop
| json field=_raw "userIdentity.sessionContext.sessionIssuer.userName" as userName nodrop
| where eventSource="kinesis.amazonaws.com"
| lookup latitude, longitude, country_code, country_name, region, city, postal_code from geo://location on ip = sourceIPAddress
| count by latitude, longitude, country_code, country_name, region, city, postal_code, eventName
| sort _count

panels.name: Kinesis API Calls Summary Table
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/Cloudtrail/Kinesis "kinesis.amazonaws.com"
| json field=_raw "eventSource", "eventName", "awsRegion", "sourceIPAddress","userAgent" nodrop
| json field=_raw "requestParameters.streamName" as streamName nodrop
| json field=_raw "userIdentity.sessionContext.sessionIssuer.userName" as userName nodrop
| json field=_raw "userIdentity.userName" as userName nodrop
| where eventSource="kinesis.amazonaws.com"
| count as count by awsRegion, userName, eventName, sourceIPAddress
| sort by count

panels.name: Kinesis API Calls Events by User
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/Cloudtrail/Kinesis "kinesis.amazonaws.com"
| json field=_raw "eventSource", "eventName", "awsRegion", "sourceIPAddress","userAgent" nodrop
| json field=_raw "requestParameters.streamName" as streamName nodrop
| json field=_raw "userIdentity.sessionContext.sessionIssuer.userName" as userName nodrop
| json field=_raw "userIdentity.userName" as userName nodrop
| where eventSource="kinesis.amazonaws.com"
| count as count by userName, eventName

panels.name: Kinesis API Calls Events by Region
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/Cloudtrail/Kinesis"kinesis.amazonaws.com"
| json field=_raw "eventSource", "eventName", "awsRegion", "sourceIPAddress","userAgent" nodrop
| json field=_raw "requestParameters.streamName" as streamName nodrop
| json field=_raw "userIdentity.sessionContext.sessionIssuer.userName" as userName nodrop
| json field=_raw "userIdentity.userName" as userName nodrop
| where eventSource="kinesis.amazonaws.com"
| count as count by awsRegion, eventName
| transpose row awsRegion column eventName

panels.name: Errors in Events
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/Cloudtrail/Kinesis "kinesis.amazonaws.com" errorCode
| json field=_raw "eventSource", "eventName", "awsRegion", "sourceIPAddress","userAgent" nodrop
| json field=_raw "requestParameters.streamName" as streamName nodrop
| json field=_raw "userIdentity.sessionContext.sessionIssuer.userName" as userName nodrop
| json field=_raw "userIdentity.userName" as userName nodrop
| json field=_raw "errorCode" as error_code nodrop
| json field=_raw "errorMessage" as error_msg nodrop
| where eventSource="kinesis.amazonaws.com"
| count by error_code, error_msg, eventName, userName, sourceIPAddress

panels.name: Top 10 IAM Users

_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/Cloudtrail/Kinesis "kinesis.amazonaws.com" 
| json field=_raw "eventSource", "eventName", "awsRegion", "sourceIPAddress","userAgent" nodrop
| json field=_raw "requestParameters.streamName" as streamName nodrop
| json field=_raw "userIdentity.sessionContext.sessionIssuer.userName" as userName nodrop
| json field=_raw "userIdentity.userName" as userName nodrop
| where eventSource="kinesis.amazonaws.com"
| count as count by userName
| sort count 
| limit 10
